shared_elements: three arched or handle-like motifs along the top
horizontal bands of repeated geometric/chevron-like marks
schematic human/body-like figure or body parts

justification: The strongest correspondence is the same distinctive scheme: a top row of three arched handle-like signs above patterned bands and a complex field of profile animals, including bird/vulture-like forms, a scorpion-like form, and small disc/body motifs in matching relative positions. The main difference is only that some lower and side details are harder to see or less fully visible in B, rather than a real difference in depicted content.
